name: yahoo-fantasy-history-exporter
description: Chrome extension that exports a Yahoo, ESPN, or Sleeper fantasy football league's full history as JSON.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content/yahoo-detector.js && node --check content/espn-bridge.js && node --check sidepanel/sidepanel.js && node --check sidepanel/providers/yahoo.js && node --check sidepanel/providers/espn.js && node --check sidepanel/providers/sleeper.js && node --check lib/archive-utils.js && node --check lib/yahoo-api.js && node --check lib/yahoo-normalizer.js && node --check lib/yahoo-session.js && node --check lib/espn-api.js && node --check lib/espn-normalizer.js && node --check lib/sleeper-api.js && node --check lib/sleeper-normalizer.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))"
